body.heading: Where in the world is Tajikistan?
paragraphs: Tajikistan is a country in Central Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Tajikistan is Dushanbe.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Tajikistan speak Tajik and Russian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Tajikistan is the Tajikistani somoni.

body.heading: How big is Tajikistan?
paragraphs: Tajikistan covers about 143,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Oman.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Pamir Highway is one of the world's highest roads, winding through the 'Roof of the World' past yaks, hot springs and views of Hindu Kush giants.
Iskanderkul is a turquoise mountain lake named for Alexander the Great, ringed by the Fann Mountains — a favourite picnic and hiking escape from Dushanbe.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Tajikistan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
